remote.settings_description: Connect WeChat so you can talk to your assistant and watch task progress from your phone.
remote.login_qr_prompt: Scan the QR code with WeChat
remote.login_expired: QR code expired. Requesting a new one...
remote.bridge_running: Bridge is online. Messages from WeChat are being routed to the assistant.
remote.bridge_stopped: Bridge stopped. Remote control is unavailable.
remote.no_inbound_handler: No assistant is wired up yet. Inbound messages will be dropped until PR-3 lands.
remote.login_feature_description: Scan the QR code to connect your computer assistant to WeChat. Receive messages anytime, anywhere.
remote.login_step_2: Scan the QR code on the left
remote.auth_section_description: Authorize WeChat users to use the remote assistant (read / write) and review grants and events. Only authorized users can trigger messages into the assistant or execute tools.
remote.auth_security_on: Security gate enabled: unauthorized users are always rejected.
remote.auth_security_off: Security gate not active: remote messages will not be auto-allowed.
remote.auth_empty: No authorizations yet. Grant one to let a WeChat user control the assistant remotely.
remote.auth_user_id_hint: Leave empty = session-wide grant (private chats / verifiable identities only; disabled by default)
remote.auth_revoke_confirm: Revoke this authorization? The user will no longer be able to enter the assistant or execute tools.
remote.auth_session_wide_hint: Session-wide grants are only for private chats with verifiable identities; group chats default to disabled — enter a user ID.
remote.auth_error_empty_chat: Chat ID must not be empty
remote.auth_error_session_wide: Session-wide grants are disabled for group / unverifiable chats by default. Enter a user ID or explicitly confirm the session is safe.
remote.auth_store_error: Failed to read authorizations; treated as rejected: {error}
